Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is all we have from this match and the ODI series as well. The Aussies were victorious in the Test series and Pakistan have now won the ODI series to get on level terms. There is still action left in this tour as there is a one-off T20I match left and both teams will be looking to win that and take bragging rights. That match will be played on the 5th of April at the Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore. Action will begin at 8.30 pm IST (3 pm GMT) but the build-up will begin much sooner. Join us then. Take care and goodbye!

Ramiz Raja, the President of the Pakistan Cricket Board take the mic and has a few words to say to the crowd as he thanks them for their continued love and support. He then presents the ODI series trophy to Babar Azam who lifts it and celebrates with his team. The Pakistan team then pose for a winning team photo.

Babar Azam, the Pakistan skipper is the Player of the Match as well as the Player of the Series for notching up 276 runs (1 fifty and 2 hundreds) in the series. He says that after losing the first match, one needs confidence to come back and credits his team for coming back strongly and putting up a good performance. Tells that if one gets early wickets in the first 10 overs then the opposition gets under pressure and the bowlers executed the plan very well. Mentions that he enjoys the pressure and tries to keep himself calm. Adds that as a captain he focuses on the result and not individual performance.

Australian skipper Aaron Finch says that they just didn't get enough runs and it's hard to put up a total when the team is three down so early on. Adds that the bowlers gave it their all and is proud of them and they just tried to go hard with the bat even after the wickets fell because any score less than 250-260 would be below par. Mentions that Travis Head and Ben McDermott played really well throughout the series and applauds the bowlers for their valiant efforts in all three matches and adds that there are a lot of positives and negatives to take away from this match. He ends by saying that they love the support here and is looking forward to the T20I match.
Presentation ceremony...

Well, the final match of the series didn't turn out to be the contest we were hoping for but nevertheless, we got to see a lot of exciting individual performances. Shaheen Afridi, Haris Rauf and Mohammad Wasim with the ball were pretty good and then the blitz from Sean Abbott, taking Afridi to the cleaners and finally the dynamic duo of Imam-ul-Haq and Babar Azam putting on yet another top-class performance. In the end, the hosts came out on top and ended up winning the ODI series. The presentation ceremony is up next.

The leading run-scorer in the series, Imam-ul-Haq is down for a quick chat. Imam says that the way the boys came back from the defeat in the first ODI is amazing. Says that it is all about self-belief and hats off to everyone for stepping up. Tells that he is a mature player now and says that he is working very hard. Mentions that Babar is his best friend and he gets along with him very well. He thanks his coaches for the support they showed him. Tells that criticism is a part of the game and he does not focus on that but he has worked hard on his game and is glad that he was able to contribute with the bat.

Revenge is sweet and after the heartbreak in the Test series, the hosts have some relief as they come from behind to clinch the ODI series. Imam-ul-Haq has certainly been like a rock at the top for Pakistan and getting him out has been the hardest thing in this series. Once again he showed his class and along with skipper Babar Azam, the pair added on 190-runs to seal the victory. Talking about Babar, he went on to score back-to-back tons and has cemented his place as a true great of the game. What a commanding performance with the bat and both batters ended up with well over 250-runs in the series, a phenomenal feat in itself.

Australia had a depleted squad and especially in the bowling department, they were fairly inexperienced. The firepower at the top though was prolific in the first two matches and with no decent score from anyone in the top four, the visitors were halfway out of the contest then and there. The bowlers had a difficult job at hand and given that most have them have never played at the highest level in such conditions, it was a near-impossible task. Nathan Ellis gave them hope at the start by sending Fakhar Zaman back but soon the hosts took the game away and the Aussies were handed a thumping defeat as they couldn't pick up another wicket in the whole innings. They will now turn their attention to the one-off T20I.

A first ODI series victory at home for Pakistan against Australia since 1988 and what a way to do it! After losing the Test series on the final day and being humbled in the first ODI, Babar Azam and co have come roaring back to clinch the three-match series 2-1 with a complete performance in the final match.

FOUR! There comes the winning runs! Imam-ul-Haq finishes it off in style. What a series this was and Imam-ul-Haq and Babar Azam have been the pillar for Pakistan. Such a comprehensive performance. Imam-ul-Haq comes down the track and smashes it to long on for a boundary. Pakistan win the match by 9 wickets and win the series 2-1!
Loopy ball, on off. Imam-ul-Haq tucks it to square leg.
Full and outside off, steered to backward point.
Full and outside off, Imam-ul-Haq comes down the track and heaves it but can't beat mid on.
Full and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne steps out and blocks it.
Scores level! On a length, on leg. Babar Azam tucks it off his pads to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Full and on off, driven to mid off.
Short of a length, outside off. Pulled to deep square leg for a single. Just 3 needed now!
Length ball, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a couple again.
On a length, on middle. Blocked out.
Length ball, on leg. Imam-ul-Haq tucks it to fine leg for a brace.
On off, worked on the leg side for a single.
Full and outside off, Babar Azam drives it through covers for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Babar Azam presses forward and looks to defend. The ball goes off the outside edge and beats Alex Carey. The batters take a brace. 200 up for Pakistan!
On middle, blocked out.

Back-to-back centuries for Babar Azam! This guy is special! Terrific knock once again from him and he just keeps on piling runs under his belt. His 16th ODI century. The crowd is going bonkers and Azam raises his bat and soaks all the applause. Gets a standing ovation from his teammates in the dressing room. Gets to the milestone by thrashing this full ball to sweeper cover for a brace. He punches the air in delight. What a moment for him and what a series is he having. Thanks the almighty as well and does the 'sajda'. Gets a warm hug from Imam-ul-Haq as well. Simply amazing!
Full and on off, Imam-ul-Haq drills it to long on for a single.
The wait continues for Babar's century. Angled into off stump, fuller as well. Azam pushes it back to the bowler.
Slower one, bowled into the pitch. Imam pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Short and wide, cut away behind square on the off side by Imam-ul-Haq. Travis Head races to his right from the point fence and dives down to cut it off. Two taken.
Around off, hit on the up towards deep extra cover for one more.
Around the top of off, tapped towards the point region.
A length ball, around leg. Ima tucks it off his hips towards fine leg for a single.
Single to end the over and Imam-ul-Haq will retain the strike. On middle and leg, wristed down to wide long on for a run.
On leg stump, worked towards mid-wicket.
Labuschagne sees Imam-ul-Haq advancing and slides it into the pads. Imam nudges it away on the leg side.
Nicely bowled! On middle, Imam keeps it out.
Around leg stump and this one keeps low. Imam does well to get it away on the leg side and in fact, they will pick up two more.
Shorter delivery, around leg. Imam-ul-Haq hops onto the back foot and works it through square leg for a couple of runs.

Drinks! Just mere formalities remain now as Pakistan are almost through. Just 25 runs are required now and Babar Azam is approaching his hundred as well. He has played a fabulous knock along with Imam-ul-Haq and it is only a matter of time before they win the series.
A low dipping full toss on off, Imam-ul-Haq strokes it down to long on for one more.
Slower one, full and on off. Imam-ul-Haq pats it back to the bowler.
Behrendorff comes 'round the wicket and serves a length ball on middle. Babar Azam hangs back and punches it past mid on for a run.
Behrendorff gets it in the blockhole. Imam digs it out to long on and rotates the strike.
On middle, nudged onto the on side and they look for the quick single but decide against it.
Very full and straight, Azam with a gentle punch back past the bowler for a single.
On middle and leg, worked off the back foot to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker and flatter, Imam-ul-Haq steps out and works it towards deep mid-wicket for a run. Just 30 required now to win.
Very full, at the toes. Babar Azam shows the full face of the bat and pushes it down to long on for yet another single.
Around off, eased down the ground for one more.
Zampa gives it much more air and floats it up outside off. Imam pushes it back to the bowler.
Drifted into middle, driven down to long on for a run.
Very full on off, Azam with a gentle push to the right of mid off for a quick single.
Pitched up, around off and this is pushed towards mis off.
FOUR! Babar Azam moves into the 90s now! Length, on the pads, just a jab behind square on the leg side and he picks up another boundary. The partnership surpasses 150 as well.
Sliding onto the pads, tucked away towards backward square leg for one more by Imam. Signalled as leg byes by the umpire.
Another easy single on offer. On the hips, turned to deep square leg by Babar.
Around the top of off, punched down to long on for an easy single.
Full and on off, Babar Azam picks the wrong 'un and hits it back to the bowler. Just 42 needed now!
Wide outside off, cut away to sweeper cover for a run.
On off, punched off the back foot to long off for one.
Full again, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq drives it through covers for a single.
Full and wide outside off, driven towards covers.
Short and on middle, Babar Azam makes room and punches it to long on for a single.
Keeps the strike for the next over! Full and on middle, pushed to long on for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Azam punches it towards covers.

FOUR! Wow! Looks like Babar Azam wants to finish it off quickly now. Full and on off, Babar Azam gets low and heaves it to wide long on for a boundary. He moves to 83! Just 47 needed now. Will he get to his century?
On a length, on off. Punched to mid on.

FOUR! Shot of the day! Just a punch! Back of a length, on off. Babar Azam transfers his weight on the back foot and opens his face of the bat. Punches it with pure timing and the ball just races away through covers.
Short ball, on off. Pulled to deep square leg for an easy single.
Loopy ball, on off. Babar Azam prods and defends it back to the bowler.
Short and wide, Imam-ul-Haq cuts it away to sweeper cover and crosses ends.
Full and outside off, driven towards covers.
Drifting on the pads, played to long on for a single.
A googly, on off. Babar Azam steps out and defends it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up nicely, on middle. Babar Azam blocks it out.
Short and on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single now.
FOUR! What a shot that is! Pure timing! Length ball, on middle and leg, Babar Azam just eases it through mid on and the ball races away to the fence. Nothing wrong with the delivery, just pure class!
On a length, on off. Babar Azam knocks it to mid on.
Back of a length, on off. Babar Azam punches it to sweeper cover for a brace.
Slower ball, well outside off. Babar Azam has a swing at it but misses.
On the pads, clipped behind square on the leg side for one.
A low full toss, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq uses his feet and works it to long on for a single.
Again dances down the track but flicks it straight to mid-wicket this time.
SIX! This time advances and sends it out of here. Loopy ball, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq shimmies down and hammers it all the way over long off for a biggie.
Imam-ul-Haq advances down the track and takes it on full but straight back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Babar Azam pushes it to long off for a run.
A googly, on middle. Babar Azam tucks it to square leg.
Around middle, worked towards mid-wicket. Marnus Labuschagne over there dives down and gets a fingertip on it. The batters get one.
Around the top of off, pushed gently towards mid on.
Full and straight, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Three dots in a row now! On middle, Imam gets behind the line of the ball to make a solid block.
Length this time, on off. Imam-ul-Haq watchfully nudges it down towards backward point.
Fullish delivery, on off. Imam hangs back and flicks it leg side.
Shorter this time from Zampa, Imam goes on the back foot and punches it to deep cover for another single.
On middle and leg, eased down to wide long on for a run.
Fifty for Imam-ul-Haq and what a series he is having! A couple of centuries followed by a well-poised half-century. On the pads, turned behind square on the leg side for one more.
Drifted into middle, Babar advances and punches it down to long off for a single.
Quicker one, speared into off. Azam pushes it towards covers.
On middle and turning away. Defended off the front foot by Azam.
Shorter, on middle and leg. This is worked off the back foot through mid-wicket for one.
Deft touch from Imam-ul-Haq and he moves on to 48. Around off, Imam waits for it and just nudges it fine past short third man. The fielder gives chase and keeps it down to three runs.
Marnus pushes it wider and Babar Azam drags it towards deep mid-wicket for just a single.
On middle and skidding through. Babar defends it out.
Around off, worked through cover-point for a single.
Floated up, outside off, Imam-ul-Haq dances down the track and hits it straight towards mid on.
This is pushed through quicker on off. Azam plays it with soft hands on the off side and looks for one but Imam sends him back.
Flatter, around off. This is cut away through covers for a couple of runs and the 100-run stand between these two is up.
FOUR! Babar Azam has eyes on the Player of the Series and wants to beat his partner to it. Slightly overpitched, on off. Azam goes inside-out with the spin and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
Fuller, on off, stroked down to long on for one more.
Flatter this time, cut away to deep point for a single.
Nicely tossed up, on off. Babar crunches it straight to the man at short cover.
Tossed up, on middle. Imam steps out but only manages to push it back towards the bowler. Marnus Labuschagne shows a bit of aggression by throwing the ball back onto the stumps.
Full, around middle, Azam strokes it towards long off for a single.
On the pads, tucked away 'round the corner for one.
Marnus drags it down a bit and bowls it on leg stump. The ball grips a bit and Imam is taken aback.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Imam-ul-Haq works it through mid-wicket and calls for two straightaway. They race back for the second and make it with ease.
Full and wide, driven to deep cover for a single.
On middle, Babar Azam pushes it to mid on and retains the strike. 99 needed from 180 balls!
Fuller, on off. Imam-ul-Haq works it to deep square leg for a single.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a brace.
Length ball, on off. Defended back to the bowler.
This is punched to mid on.
On a length, on middle. Blocked out.

The crowd goes Babar, Babar and he gets his fifty. Another half century. His 19th overall. Full and outside off, Babar Azam leans and drives it through covers for a single. Raises his bat to acknowledge all the praise and chants. It's been a fine knock from him!
Full and on leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
Floats it up, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq rocks back and taps it to point for a quick single.
A full toss, outside off. Babar Azam misses out on that one. Drags it off the inner half of the bat to long on for one. He moves to 49!
On the shorter length, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq presses forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Full and on leg, nudged to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, on off. Kept out.
FOUR! It's difficult to stop Babar Azam when he gets going! Length ball, outside off. Babar Azam stands tall, opens the face of the bat and drives it neatly past point for a boundary.
Length, on off. Punched off the front foot to cover.
Length ball, angling in, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq hops and tucks it to mid-wicket for a run.
A full toss, on off. Imam-ul-Haq drives it back to the bowler.
This is eased down to long off for one.
Floats it up, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq drives it to cover.
Full and on middle, pushed to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, Babar Azam steps out and heaves it to mid off. Didn't quite time it well but the ball falls just short of the fielder.
Tossed up wide outside off, Imam-ul-Haq chases it and slashes it to deep cover for a single.
Loopy ball, on leg. Clipped to deep square leg for a single.

Drinks! The target is a small one, Pakistani batters are in form and with just one batter back in the hut, Babar Azam and his troops will look to make short work of it. Australia need wickets and they need both Imam-ul-Haq and Babar Azam in the space of a couple of overs to have an outside chance. The middle-order hasn't been tested much and the visitors have to somehow get rid of the set batters, which isn't going to be easy. Pakistan need 115 runs with 34 overs still left and this seems a straightforward chase.

FOUR! This time Imam-ul-Haq gets a boundary. Yet again a short delivery from Sean Abbott to Imam-ul-Haq and this time Imam-ul-Haq swivel-pulls it nicely to deep square leg and fetches himself a boundary.
On a length, on middle. Babar Azam clips it to deep mid-wicket and crosses ends.
Good-length ball, on middle. Babar Azam stands tall and blocks.
Short ball once again, on leg. This time Imam-ul-Haq pulls it to fine leg. Will only get a single though.
Bangs it short, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq sits under it.
Length ball, on middle. Babar Azam tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, pushed down the ground for a single by Babar Azam. He moves into the 40s now.
Flatter this time, around off. Imam-ul-Haq punches it off the back foot towards long on and collects a run.
Around leg stump, eased down to long on for one more.
Quicker one, on the pads. Azam nudges it towards square leg.
Outside off, driven with the spin through the cover region for one more.
Full and angled across the off stump. Azam jams it out towards extra cover for a single.

Brilliant effort from Nathan Ellis in the deep and saves three runs. Short of a length, sits up nicely for the batter. Babar Azam rolls his wrists over the ball and pulls it towards deep square leg. Ellis runs around from the mid-wicket fence and keeps it down to a single.
Good comeback from Green. Bangs it in short and at the body. Babar manages to keep it down on the leg side.
Fuller this time, on off. This is driven straight towards mid off.
Slanted into middle, Azam keeps it out on the leg side.
FOUR! Poor bowling from Green and he is punished! Down the leg side, flicked away fine and Azam gets back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Pakistan on the charge here! Pitched up, outside off. Babar Azam stays leg side of the ball, stands tall and drives it through covers for another boundary.

FOUR! Imam-ul-Haq picks the gap perfectly and Pakistan keep on getting a boundary almost every over. On middle, Imam uses his feet and lofts it right into the gap between deep mid-wicket and long on for a boundary. The 50 partnership is up between these two.
On middle turned onto the leg side for one.
Azam looking to be a bit too aggressive at the moment. Nicely flighted, around off. Azam steps out and mistimes the cover drive completely.
Quicker one, sliding into middle and leg. Blocked out.
Misses out on that one! Tossed up again, around off. Babar Azam steps out, converts it into a full toss but smashes it straight to the man at extra cover. Azam is livid with himself.
Tossed up, on off. Imam-ul-Haq dances down the track and mistimes the straight drive just past Zampa for a single.
Around the top of off, eased away towards cover-point.

FOUR! Cameron Green bowls the exact same from as he did on the last delivery and this time Babar Azam latches onto it. Short, around the hips and pulled away into the fine leg fence. The crowd is chanting 'Babar, Babar' now.
Short of a length, on middle. Azam tucks it towards square leg.
Full and on off, pushed out towards covers.
It's pretty easy at the moment for these two out there. Short ball, angled into the helmet. Imam-ul-Haq pulls it down to fine leg for one more.
Back of a length, angled into off. Azam makes a bit of room and plays it through covers for one.
Floated up, full and on off. Azam punches it down to long on for a single.
Zampa gives it more air and bowls it around middle and leg. Babar nudges it onto the leg side.
It's misfields galore today from Australia. Quicker one, darted into middle. Imam flicks it straight to the man at mid-wicket who misfields and allows a single.
Here comes the wrong 'un, fuller and on middle. Imam manages to keep it out.
FOUR! Swept away and swept away really nicely. On the pads, Imam-ul-Haq lifts it over backward square leg and picks up a boundary.
This is pushed through on off. Imam blocks it out.
Done with Powerplay 1! The fielding side can now have a maximum of 4 players outside the inner ring till the 40th over.
On a length, on of. Babar Azam knocks it to mid on off the back foot. At the end of the first Powerplay, Pakistan are 54/1.
On a length, on leg. Imam-ul-Haq clips it off his pads to deep square leg for a single.
Good running between the wickets! Touch fuller, on middle. Babar Azam pushes it gently to mid on and sets off for a quick single. Gets it quite comfortably.
Back of a length, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq slashes it to deep cover for a single this time.
Good length, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq cuts it hard to backward point.
WIDE! Length ball down leg, Imam-ul-Haq misses his tuck. Wide called.
On a length, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq guides it to point.
Cameron Green is introduced into the attack now.
FOUR! Just a tickle! An off-paced ball, again on the pads. Babar Azam clears his front leg and clips it to fine leg for another boundary. 50 up for Pakistan!
Good-length ball, on middle. Babar Azam covers the line and blocks it out.
Full and on the pads, Azam clips it to square leg.
On a length, outside off. Babar Azam punches it towards covers.
FOUR! That is so good! Short and on leg, at 131 clicks. Babar Azam picks the length quickly and pulls it to deep square leg. The ball races away into the fence.
On a good length, on off. Babar Azam meets it with a dead bat.
A googly, on off. Imam-ul-Haq reads it and blocks it out.
This is nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Full, on middle. Tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq looks to drive but gets a leading edge back to the bowler. Luckily for him, the ball falls short of Zampa.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Loopy ball, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq dances down the track and smashes it over covers for a boundary.
Floats it up, on off. Babar Azam stays back and works it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, Imam-ul-Haq looks to drive. The ball goes off the outside edge but doesn't carry to Alex Carey as it was played with soft hands.
Slower ball, on the pads. Babar Azam simply flicks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
On middle, defended to silly mid on.
Length, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq works it to deep square leg and rotates the strike.
On a good length, around off. Imam-ul-Haq keeps it out.
On the pads and Imam-ul-Haq clips it to deep square leg. He calls for two and gets it easily.
Good length, on middle. Babar Azam stands tall and knocks it back to the bowler.
This is flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Full again, on middle. Imam-ul-Haq drives it back to the bowler.
On a length, on middle. Babar Azam nudges it to wide mid on for a single.
FOUR! Solid shot! Timed it to perfection! Fuller and on off, Babar Azam opens the face of the bat and drives it so elegantly through mid off for a boundary.
Length ball, on off. Babar Azam punches it to mid off.
A length ball, on off. Imam-ul-Haq keeps it down on the off side.
A low full toss on the pads. Babar flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Uppish but safe! Full and wide, driven towards covers.
On the stumps, blocked out.

Dropped! How big of a drop this could prove to be? Around the pads, flicked away straight to Travis Head at square leg. The ball is just a bit higher and Head fumbles an easy chance. The batters get back for the second as well.
Length, on middle. Azam keeps it out.
Ooh, that wasn't too far away from the man at silly mid on. Length again, on off and a bit slower. Babar Azam looks to drive on the up but gets it off the toe end towards mid on for a single.
Around the top of off, blocked out.
Babar Azam walks out to bat at No.3.

OUT! TAKEN! Australia do have the early breakthrough and the dangerman Fakhar Zaman departs! Change of pace from Nathan Ellis as he bowls a slower one, fuller and on the pads. Zaman looks to work it leg side but closes the face of the blade early and gets a leading edge towards mid off. Marnus Labuschagne dives in front to take a really good catch and the Aussies are in the game.
Commentary.Howout: c Marnus Labuschagne b Nathan Ellis

Commentary.Commentary: On the pads, clipped away through mid-wicket for one more.
Length again, around off, this is played through point for a run.

FOUR! Lucky boundary for Fakhar Zaman but he'll take it. A length ball, pitching on off and just nipping back in a bit. Zaman looks to drive but gets an inside edge past leg stump and the ball runs away into the fine leg fence.
Short of a length, angled into the body. Imam hops and keeps it down on the leg side.
Short and wide, this is crunched but the fielder at backward point does well to get a hand on it. Single taken.
Drifted onto the pads, tucked away behind square on the leg side for a single.
On middle, kept out on the off side.
Another misfield, very uncharacteristic of the Aussies. Back of a length, punched off the back foot towards Ben McDermott at covers who lets the ball through his hands. The batters pick up a single.
Length ball, slanting into middle. Zaman works it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! What a way to get off the mark! Just short of a length, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq hangs deep and picks it up nonchalantly to lift it one bounce into the mid-wicket fence.
Pitched up, on off. Imam pushes it towards mid off.
WIDE! Ellis spills it down the leg side. Wided.
Full again, on off. Imam-ul-Haq punches it straight back towards the bowler.
Around middle and leg, clipped away to short mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, jammed out to the man at extra cover.
Ellis pitches it up to start and bowls it on off. Imam defends it out solidly.
Nathan Ellis will operate from the other end.

Misfield and four! Good-length, around off. Fakhar Zaman stands tall and hits it on the up. The ball goes through the hands of the fielder at point and races away into the fence. 10 off the first over and Pakistan are off to a flier.
Bit of width on offer, Zaman mistimes it towards the cover region.
This is angled into the pads, tucked away through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
FOUR! A freebie from Behrendorff and Fakhar Zaman is underway. Short and wide, Zaman stands tall and slaps it through point for a boundary.
Length again, around the top of off and Zaman blocks it out.
Jason Behrendorff starts off with a length ball, outside off and the ball shapes away nicely. Fakhar Zaman leaves it alone.
